items.title: Pumpkin spice curry
items.description: with jasmine fragrant rice, fresh vegetables, grilled pumpkin, fresh coriander, seed mix, sesame, pumpkin spice and mango coconut sauce.

items.title: Pumpkin Chai Matcha Latte
items.description: A spicy chai base meets a homemade matcha base and is combined with steamed milk. The result is a balanced hot drink with a creamy texture that combines the bitter, aromatic note of matcha with the warming spice of pumpkin spice.
